items.title: 1 Healthcare Stock to Keep an Eye On and 2 We Avoid
items.summary: Healthcare companies are pushing the status quo by innovating in areas like drug development and digital health. Those leading the charge have not only realized strong financial performance but also propelled the broader industry’s returns as healthcare stocks have gained 14.3% over the past six months while the S&P 500 was up 6.3%.
